messages:
support_olivia: Customer 'Acme Retail' reported a billing spike tied to a prompt that contained an SSN. They want us to redact PII and provide repro steps. They gave request IDs 0af3b9e2, 0af3b9f7, 0af3ba20. CC @eng_rebecca @security_ryan @legal_ana
eng_rebecca: Can you paste the full X-Request-ID header and the exact API call? If you have the curl we can try a local repro. Was there an error code or just model echo? 4xx/5xx?
support_olivia: No 5xx — responses returned 200 but the model output included the SSN. Latency normal. I'll attach the raw request ids. We can't post raw prompt publicly.
tooling_bot: Tip: run `rw-debug bundle --requests 0af3b9e2,0af3b9f7 --sanitize` to generate a sanitized debug bundle. It redacts configured PII patterns and uploads to private S3. :robot_face:
eng_rebecca: Running logs now. For reproductions, please run this sanitized curl before sharing externally:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: 0af3b9e2" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xxx","input":"Please summarize customer note: [REDACTED_SSN]"}'
```
support_olivia: I'll paste that in the ticket. Quick Q: is replacing SSN with Xs enough or do you want a hash? @security_ryan?
security_ryan: Do NOT share plaintext SSNs. Prefer either replace digits with X (e.g., XXX-XX-XXXX) or sha256 hash. If eng needs plaintext for repro, we need written customer consent and Legal approval. I'll open an access request for the full bundle.
legal_ana: Confirmed: hashed SSN is acceptable for debugging. If plaintext is required to reproduce a model behavior that masks or formats digits differently, we need explicit consent. I'll draft a short consent template and ping the customer.
cust_success_jin: Customer replied — they prefer masked SSNs and deletion of any full bundles after 30 days. They're open to granting consent if absolutely necessary.
eng_rebecca: I pulled the sanitized bundle and reproduced locally. In this case the model is echoing placeholder tokens when prompt had an unescaped template variable. Quick mitigation: add server-side sanitizer to strip digit sequences from fields labeled 'sensitive' and a detection rule to flag possible SSNs. I'll open a PR with fix + tests; ETA EOD.
support_olivia: Thanks — I'll attach the sanitized bundle to the ticket, link the PR, and ask customer for consent if we need full content. Marking support thread as in-progress :white_check_mark:
